Jack plays badminton with Grace every Sunday. Grace is interested in reading. Jack hopes to visit Tokyo one day. After college he found full-time work.
Last Sunday, Jack and Grace went to the meeting room. There are always many people at the coffee corner. Jack and Grace had great fun there. They import coffee from Brazil.
Jack spent the weekend at the library. The meeting room is one of the best places in the city. The weather was snowy that day. What's more, overtime pay is time and a half.
Both of them like bread and juice. Life is full of small surprises. Jack's favorite animal is the dog.
